content: {"summary":"On 10 Mar 2026 the edge‑gateway rate limiter was set to 100 tokens / s per pod (300 / s total). Search traffic peaked at ~420 / s, exceeding the limit and causing 429 EDGE‑RL01 responses from all three edge pods. The limit was later raised to 250 / s per pod (750 / s total) via a ConfigMap change and a rolling restart, after which the 429s stopped.","likely_cause":"Per‑pod rate‑limit of 100 requests / s was too low for the campaign traffic, triggering 429 responses before requests reached search‑api.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Original per‑pod limit was 100 tokens per second","evidence_ids":["RB-030#1"],"quote":"it was 100 tokens a second on each of the three"},{"text":"Search traffic peaked at about 420 requests a second","evidence_ids":["RB-030#1"],"quote":"peaked at about 420 requests a second"},{"text":"Limit was raised to 250 a second per pod","evidence_ids":["RB-030#2"],"quote":"raised the limit to 250 a second per pod"},{"text":"New total edge capacity became 750 requests per second","evidence_ids":["RB-030#3"],"quote":"That's 750 for the edge, about 1.8 times the campaign's peak"}],"next_checks":["Verify the current edge‑gateway ConfigMap values for rate limits","Confirm that the rolling restart completed on all edge pods","Monitor edge‑gateway rate‑limit counters for any future spikes"]}
